notes.title: Release Date - Series Premiere August 18
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39322242/7f9339277da1ed54fe650487028bfad708f4bf20.jpg[/img]

Hiiii everyone! WE HAVE A RELEASE DATE! It's happening!

Our interactive series AND our band's new music will start releasing in 2 weeks, on Thursday, August 18th! If you buy the game, you'll get all episodes include, plus their interactive music videos! New episodes will unlock every week, for a total of 5 episodes, 5 songs!

[previewyoutube=Mu2iKC4fVDs;full][/previewyoutube]

Check out our new trailer, featuring "Fool's Gold" our new single also dropping August 18 along with episodes 1 + 2!!!

Thank you all who've been cheering us on! Almost 5 years of indie development to make our weird project REAL!!!! Can't wait to hear what you think of the music! And the game!!

xo
~ Team OFK
